notes.title: New Weapons! MP41(r) and ZK-383 Now Available + Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
New weapons and some bug fixing! Wanted to give you all a quick follow up to the British update from a couple of weeks ago. In this update you're getting access to the MP41R and ZK-383 SMGs. As well as some bug fixes related to the menus and settings. Below is some info about the new SMGs!

[h2]MP41R[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36289249/e38467cd198f22b8655fe47a6941a67e1afe1fbd.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36289249/c01c07d725eb0e751bff970a2b7a243341cbed42.png[/img]

The MP41R or MP41(r) may look familiar, an awful lot like a PPSH-41 actually. That's because it is, just modified by the Germans after capture. After the Germans captured vast quantities of PPSH-41 SMGs during and after Operation Barbarossa, they rechambered some of these for 9mm Parabellum to cut down on the variety of ammo they needed to supply their soldiers with. This conversion was done pretty substantial numbers, at least 10,000 but possibly more. A side effect of the rechambering was a small slow down from the insanely fast fire rate of the PPSH-41. 

It showed up in the Eastern and Western front primarily, but was sometimes found in Yugoslavia and Italy. After the war they would even be found in the stocks of the North Korean forces in the Korean War. It also uses 32 round MP40 magazines like the MP3008. In-game this also applies and you can replenish ammo from MP3008s or MP40s. They're available now when you're playing as the Axis forces on the Western Front. Not quite the PPSH-41 (which will of course arrive with the Soviets), but it should hold you over until that arrives. Lower damage is made up for a with a high fire rate, great for spraying down multiple enemies at close range when you're storming an objective.

[h2]ZK-383[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36289249/c9da5316aa3ae8adc10caff0ec4b37b0f5df6838.png[/img]

The ZK-383 is a Czech SMG that was originally conceived to be an LMG. It was modified until the final product was a sturdy SMG delivering great range, manageable recoil, and a pretty powerful punch. The ZK-383 has a 30 round magazine and can be found when playing as the Axis or Allies for maps set in Yugoslavia or Italy. You can also find a ZK-383 in Nuremberg as a pick up weapon. The weapon was used by the Waffen SS that continued production in occupied Czechoslovakia for their own use. It was also used by Bulgaria, and captured Bulgarian examples would be used by the Yugoslav partisans. The weapon was well liked by both sides and would see usage in Yugoslavia and throughout Europe for the duration of the war. 

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

Bug fixes are mentioned in the patch notes below, concerning the new menus and errors with settings sometimes not saving or being set to the incorrect default values. 

Thanks for playing, and enjoy!

Patch Notes:
-Added MP41R to the game and to weapon select screens for Western Front Germans/Axis
-Added ZK383 to the weapon select screen for Balkan and Italian Theater Axis forces as well as Yugoslav Partisan faction
-ZK383 was previously available hidden in Vallo Alpino, is still there and is also in Nuremberg now as pick up weapon
-Fixed issue where some users audio settings would default to the lowest volume
-Fixed issues with visual and other settings not saving properly
-Fixed pause menu options not loading correctly

notes.title: British Update is Finally Here! - British Faction, 3 New Maps, New Menu & More!
notes.notes:
Sorry this took so long, but thank you so much to you all for waiting for this update. I hope you'll like it! This update is a big one, and from now on updates will thankfully not take so long now that this is out. Given the day this has happened to release, Happy 4th of July to all the Americans out there! (Sorry to our British friends, very stereotypical of us to get ourselves in your update somehow)

[h2]What's Included[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]The British as a new faction[/b] - With them come [b]3 new maps[/b], bringing our total to 12. As well as a new set of weapons which are detailed later.

[*][b]All new animations[/b] - Almost every weapon has new first person animations, all but the pistols have been totally replaced with much better animations

[*][b]New menus[/b] - The main menu as well as in-game menus have been replaced. These look much nicer now and also feature far better support for controller and keyboard navigation.

[*][b]13 New weapons[/b] - There are [b]13 new weapons[/b] for you to use, these are all listed further down. Also there is an additional bonus weapon that will be part of the next update that you can test out in Vallo Alpino now! Damage is also now more affected by range for balance purposes, this is done in a performant way that won't affect how shooting functioned otherwise.

[*][b]New customization for match creation[/b] - You can now set score and time limits for all game modes easily in the new menus, as well as customize other options like friendly fire, and how many players or bots you want in the match. Much more customization will come soon.

[*][b]Improved AI[/b] - Though still a work in progress until the next update, the AI are much more capable of meeting their potential. A coming engine upgrade will help them get to the point where they are much more interesting and challenging.

[*][b]New graphical/technical features[/b] - Support for upscaling technologies like DLSS and FSR 1 and 2 have been added, providing more ways to get better performance for all PCs that support them. Reflex has also been added for Nvidia users that want lower input latency. Vulkan support has also been added, running with the launch option -vulkan via Proton for Linux users should improve performance there.

[*][b]And much more![/b] - See the expanded section below for the full patch details

[/list]

[h2]New Maps[/h2]

[b]Broadcast[/b]: Set outside of Hamburg, you'll fight for control over a German radio broadcast station.  A mid size map with buildings surrounding a hill with the broadcast station located on top.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36289249/5dbfafd67879449b7228d160468f06ec4acb1458.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36289249/b72eb3b61ca0ca92a6ddeac99f6ac11e5e00e89e.png[/img]

[b]Reichswald[/b]: The Reichswald forest saw some of the toughest fighting in the British drive into Germany.  You'll maneuver between the rocks and trees in a forest ripe for close quarters combat.  Stay out of the open center though to avoid the bunkers built into the ground!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36289249/95a5b124e40d94a9718c9c4ead43105e80f505d0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36289249/0086d8634164210fd240f0305c26e6637675fd4d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36289249/ebd826298b7e40d6fbd97212b4623c3c13c7efc0.png[/img]

[b]Steinbruch[/b]: A stone mine in the Rhine, where you'' fight over the main building in close quarters, and between the equipment and stone outside. Lots of verticality, offset by the open space the opportunities provide.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36289249/8e4df38bae8662cab782b40f07fbb3fb1e80d9ba.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36289249/d8d93128eb0d01a88b122f947e734119248e7106.png[/img]

[h2]New weapons[/h2]

[olist]
[*] Carcano M91/41
[*] Carcano M91/41 Scoped
[*] Bren
[*] Double Barrel Shotgun
[*] MP-3008
[*] FG-42
[*] Lee-Enfield
[*] Lee-Enfield Scoped
[*] MAB 38
[*] Breda PG Export (Burst)
[*] VG-1 [b]End of War 1945 is also the very first game to feature this rifle of the Volkssturmgewehr series![/b]
[*] VG-1 Scoped
[*] TZ-45
[*] +1 Bonus weapon you'll find on Vallo Alpino!
[/olist]

You can also check out all the new animations yourself! Or watch the earlier reel of animations from the last announcement, although seeing them in game will reflect the most up to date effects.

[h2]Future Plans[/h2]

Before the rest of the patch notes, I'd also like to confirm that the game is still being worked on. The next updates will be more incremental but the next major release will be the one that takes us out of early access! Lots more to come with that one. Support for matchmaking, improved AI, Soviet faction, new maps for the Eastern Front, many new weapons, announcer voice acting for each faction, as well as improved controller support are just some of the features coming next. I promise it won't take as long as this one did :)


[h2]Additional patch notes[/h2]

[list]
[*] The Axis fighting in Yugoslavia and Italy are also now their own faction with their own unique weapons.

[*]Networking stability has been improved

[*]Support for DLSS 2.3 as well as FSR 1.0 and 2.1

[*]Support for Reflex and Reflex + Boost

[*]Improved textures for the MP40, as well as new sounds for the Kar98K, Gewehr 43, M1 Carbine, M1 Garand, Thompson, TT33, and KP-31

[*]Damage adjustments to every weapon for balancing

[*] Grenade throwing animations improved

[*] Grenade is now thrown further and faster

[*] Melee is faster and has improved animations

[*] Improved sound effects for grenade and knife

[*]Fixed various collision bugs on Monrupino

[*]And a lot more bug fixes that were solved with all the overhauls to the game mentioned above

[/list]

notes.title: Progress Update For Coming Update - Weapon Animation Reel and More!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, sorry for not being more active on posting progress updates for the coming update. I wouldn't blame you if you thought the project was just abandoned as so many are sadly, if I were you my mood on this update would probably be similar to the thumbnail for this announcement too. Fear not though, I hope you were hanging in there because its about to finally arrive! 

This update was originally announced at the very end of 2020 (my apologies), as an update bringing the British as a new faction for the game. Since then it grew to what is essentially a revamp of the whole game. The menus are new, the gun mechanics function differently, and speaking of guns there's a lot more variety there now too. Also, every weapon except the pistols has received a new set of animations entirely (Link to a quick run through of those below). There's 3 new maps for a total of 12, and the existing ones have been revised too, there's ~35 unique character models in the game when it originally launched with just 3. Also there's going to be graphical, networking, and AI related improvements. 

I wanted to be able to show everything that's been worked on over the last couple of years, but most of its back end stuff that isn't really anything to show off. However the time has finally come where its coming together and progress becomes more VISIBLE in the literal sense. I'd like to finally present some screenshots of the new maps and a reel of the new animations! 

There's still polishing to do, and you can see that below where the textures for example on some of the foliage in Reichswald haven't loaded properly, but we're really in the home stretch here. For all those still hanging on, thank you so much and I hope the update brings you some enjoyment, and this news holds you over for now.  More updates to follow in the coming weeks leading up to the release, stay tuned!

notes.title: Movement Update - v.0.4.6.0
notes.notes:
This is a small update to help improve the overall game before the large update adding the British as a faction. Movement has been improved and tweaked, along with some additional graphical enhancements, sound changes, and bug fixes. 

[h2][b]Movement Changes and Improvements:[/b][/h2]

notes.title: Huge Performance and Install Size Improvements - Version 0.2.3.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Blueprint Nativization[/h1]

This update brings Blueprint Nativization to nearly all of the UE4 blueprints used in End of War 1945. Bleuprints and C++ are both used together in Unreal Engine 4 games, and C++ has a major advantage in efficiency. You can however, gain much of this back by nativizing blueprint assets. The conversion process is buggy which is why it's taken this long, but as a result nearly every aspect of the game should see performance improvements. Even on higher end PCs, you'll likely not see drops and hitches where you once did.

[h1]Install Size Reduction[/h1]

The game install size has been compressed from around 35GB to only 21GB with this new update. This is all lossless compression and doesn't reduce the quality of assets at all. Load times may see a boost as a result. This will allow the game to maintain an acceptable install size as further maps and factions are released.

[h1]New M1 Carbine Sight[/h1]

The M1 Carbine sight has been adjusted for greater visibility.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36289249/8e55be05f3a0d429a4dadd913a7ee8771024991e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Full Patch Notes[/h1]

-Rebuilt/Improved Endsieg lighting quality
-Improved the visbility for the iron sights on the M1 Carbine
-Blueprint Nativization
-Fixed an issue with CTF on Trieste not working properly
-Enabled lossless compression to reduce game install size

Also looking into ways to boost the player count, standby for more on that.

notes.title: New Map! + Patches - Tappelwerch - Version 0.2.0.0
notes.notes:
[h1]Update 0.2.0.0[/h1]

Our biggest post Early Access release update, the main attraction being our [b]new map[/b] [u]Tappelwerch[/u]! This snow themed map takes place during a German offensive to clear a path of retreat for their forces in the Balkans. This village was burned, and later bombed, before falling into use by the Yugoslav Partisans in 1944-1945. It's a large map with chaotic house to house fighting, available to play on all 5 game modes.

notes.title: German Compatible Version Available Now!

This version is fully compatible with the version the rest of the world has, the differences are purely cosmetic to remove symbols illegal in Germany. Hope you like the game and continue to check it out as it gets updates in the future. Glad to finally have you on board!

notes.title: 1 Week to Release!
notes.notes:
It's been quite a while, but right now the game is being prepared for its Early Access release! 

We're doing some final polishing here and there to make sure everything works well on release. 

We'll also be having a closed beta/reviewer period on the 6th, but until then we'll be uploading more information about the gamemodes, weapons, and what to expect when you play on the 8th. 

The release also coincides with the 75th anniversary of V.E. Day!

Be sure to wishlist and follow us here on Steam to be notified when we release!

We'll see you and your squad on the battlefield!

-The 45th Division
